item.title: Inside Lego's Artemis 2 range: Which set delivers the best build, detail and value?
item.description: Space fans looking for a Lego Artemis set to build now have an interesting conundrum, as there are two Lego NASA Space Launch System Artemis 2 sets to choose from.

item.title: 'Star Wars Outlaws' scores a new prequel novel starring antagonist Jaylen Vrax and his ND-5 assassin droid
item.description: Author Mike Chen returns fans to the galaxy's grimy underworld in this thrilling crime caper book

item.title: Rocket Lab's 'Hungry Hippo' Neutron fairing arrives at spaceport in Virginia
item.description: The "hungry hippo" fairing for Rocket Lab's new Neutron launch vehicle has arrived for integration at the company's Virginia Spaceport facilities.

item.title: Proteins before planets: How space ice may have created the 1st building blocks of life
item.description: "We used to think that only very simple molecules could be created in these clouds. But we have shown that this is clearly not the case."

item.title: SpaceX targeting mid-March for 1st flight of bigger, more powerful Starship 'Version 3,' Elon Musk says
item.description: SpaceX plans to launch the 12th test flight of its Starship megarocket in six weeks, according to Elon Musk. It will be the first mission of the bigger, more powerful Starship "V3."

item.title: See the Milky Way glow with the stars of the Summer Triangle above Egypt's Black Desert
item.description: Deneb, Vega and Altair are among the brightest stars in the night sky.

item.title: How Earth's atmosphere and climate come together to create a polar vortex
item.description: To understand what Americans are experiencing with this winter blast, we need to look more than 20 miles above the surface of Earth, to the stratospheric polar vortex.

item.title: NASA exoplanet probe tracks interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS to gauge its spin
item.description: The interstellar visitor may still have a few things to tell us before it leaves our solar system.

item.title: NASA and SpaceX move up launch of Crew-12 astronauts to Feb. 11 as relief crew after ISS medical evacuation
item.description: NASA and SpaceX are proceeding ahead of schedule with their next astronaut launch to the International Space Station, which is currently operating with a skeleton crew.

item.title: James Webb Space Telescope reveals new origin story for the universe's 1st supermassive black holes
item.description: Recent James Webb Space Telescope data confirms a decade-old theory that the universe's earliest supermassive black holes formed without stars.
